```{r}
library(slingshot)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scran)
library(scater)
library(igraph)
```

```{r}
catcar <- readRDS("car_only_basic_annotation.rds")
```

### extract individual elements of data for slingshot input
```{r}
dimred <- catcar@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
clustering <- catcar$basic_clusters
counts <- catcar[["RNA"]]$counts
```

```{r}
set.seed(61)
lineages <- getLineages(data = dimred, clusterLabels = clustering, start.clus = "c6")

lineages
```

```{r}
palette <- ggsci::pal_d3("category20")(20)

# Create a color lookup table
cluster_cols <- setNames(
  palette[seq_along(levels(clustering))],
  levels(clustering)
)

# Assign a color to each cell based on its cluster
cell_cols <- cluster_cols[as.character(clustering)]
```

### extracting MST and nodes to plot manually using ggplot
```{r}
mst <- slingMST(lineages)

nodes <- data.frame(
  cluster = V(mst)$name,
  do.call(rbind, vertex_attr(mst, "coordinates"))
)

colnames(nodes)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

nodes
```

```{r}
edge_list <- as.data.frame(get.edgelist(mst))

colnames(edge_list) <- c("from", "to")
```

```{r}
edges <- edge_list %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "cluster")) %>%
  rename(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cluster")) %>%
  rename(xend = UMAP_1, yend = UMAP_2)

edges
```

```{r}
cell_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1 = dimred[,1],
  UMAP_2 = dimred[,2],
  cluster = clustering
)

ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = cluster), size = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = xend,
      yend = yend
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
    geom_point(
    data = nodes,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_cols) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
curves <- getCurves(lineages, approx_points = 150, thresh = 0.01, stretch = 0.8, allow.breaks = FALSE, shrink = 0.99)
curves
```

```{r}
curve_dfs <- lapply(seq_along(slingCurves(curves)), function(i) {

  crv <- slingCurves(curves)[[i]]

  data.frame(
    UMAP_1 = crv$s[,1],
    UMAP_2 = crv$s[,2],
    lineage = paste0("Lineage_", i),
    order = seq_len(nrow(crv$s))
  )
})

curve_df <- do.call(rbind, curve_dfs)
```

```{r}
ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = cluster),
    size = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(
      UMAP_1,
      UMAP_2,
      group = lineage
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_cols) +
  theme_classic()
```
